title: Where does "Still owed here" sit: on the order line, or under the card lines?
ref: debt duo-hand-mockup-gaps; decision duo-card-in-hand; lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237)
context:
Goal: see what this package still owes while the keys are up.
Problem (goal): round 2 puts it under the lines, which falls under the keys at 3 or more lines.
Based on (read): decision outstanding-value-per-level (each level states what is still outstanding).
Departs from: the round 2 place under the lines — the trailing end of the "ordered" line.
Asked by lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237, mockup docs/design/duo-hand-gaps.html at 4362dc5). The picks per part live in docs/design/duo-hand-gaps-notes.md.

options.label: On the order line
options.how: "Still owed here" and the figure sit at the trailing end of the "ordered" line.
options.gain: No new row, and it stays above the keys.
options.lose: A busier line, which wraps at large text.

options.label: Under the lines
options.how: It sits under the card lines, as round 2 drew it.
options.gain: It reads after the lines it sums.
options.lose: The keys hide it at 3 or more lines.

why: It stays in view while you type, at every length of envelope.
